facts.fact: Addis Fortune reports a USD 30 million pilot, financed by a Korea Exim Bank loan through the Ministry of Urban and Infrastructure, kicked off in March 2024 to bring drone cadastre mapping and integrated land title registration to Hawassa, Bahir Dar, Welayta Sodo and Adama.

systems.country_label: Land title and cadastre pilot, four cities

facts.fact: Addis Fortune reports the digitisation of more than 700,000 land titles in Addis Ababa was completed weeks before March 2024 and the service was due to open for public use that month, while a USD 30 million Korea Exim-financed pilot began in four other cities.
